newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 13.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 13.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones dropped 45.79 points to 7,039.37. PLDT's ADR dipped $0 1/4 to $60 5/8.
* The peso closed steady at 26.322 to the dollar.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index fell 10.35 points to 3,270.64.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average was unchanged at 10.28125 percent.

* Newspaper BusinessWorld says the Philippine Association of National Advertisers will continue its boycott on ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp unless the latter agrees to a maximum 15 percent hike in primetime advertising rates. (MANILA TIMES/MALAYA)
* BusinessWorld reports the Manila Electric Co generated a 5.063 billion peso net income, up by 14.8 percent from 4.411 billion in 1995.
* BusinessWorld says Ayala Land will declassify its B and unlisted A shares upon the request of the Philippine Stock Exchange.
* Philippine Daily Inquirer says the Sugar Regulatory Administration approved the sale to the local market of some 500,000 tonnes of refined sugar by Victorias Milling Co.
* Manila Times reports that the Philippine Stock Exchange will prepare clear guidelines on the hiring and firing of exchange personnel to avoid the recent spate of resignations at the bourse.
* Today says Jardine Davies may be interested in buying into the cash-strapped Victorias Milling Corp.
